recipes.name: Beef Broth (RtP)
recipes.description: Kaldu daging sapi dengan perbandingan 1:1 (1kg tulang dan 1 kg air).

prep.text: with room temp. water (1-2 min/kg). Pat dry or air dry to prevent uneven browning.
prep.title: Rinse

options.label: Immediate use
options.text: Scoop the beef broth and skim the beef tallow. Keep broth ≥ 60°C.

options.label: Store
options.text: Immediately cool down until 21°C within 2 hr using ice bath, to 5°C within next 4 hr in the freezer. Label production date. Thaw in fridge before use.

finish.title: Beef tallow
finish.text: After storing the broth in the fridge, a golden layer will be formed on top. Scrape this and store as Beef Tallow, useful later. When used immediately, skim the fat layer and store it.

ingredients.name: Knuckle/joint bones/femur
ingredients.description: Saw to smaller pieces if possible.

ingredients.name: Marrow bones
ingredients.description: Tulang sumsum. More is better. Saw to smaller pieces if possible.

ingredients.name: Neck bones
ingredients.description: Saw to smaller pieces if possible.

ingredients.name: Filtered Water
ingredients.description: Compensating evaporation during cooking process. 30% more.

procedures.title: Roasting
procedures.instructions: 200°C, 30-40 min, golden brown. Aluminum foil underneath. Turn once halfway.
procedures.tools: Could set to highest temp. with shorter time

procedures.title: Parboil
procedures.instructions: Start boiling. Heat to 100°C, then 3-5 min, just enough water. Stir occationally. Dump water.

procedures.title: Rinse
procedures.instructions: 40-50°C high-pressure water. Only clean surface briefly.

procedures.title: Simmer
procedures.instructions: 24 hrs. Start cold, heat to below simmering (92 C). Skim in first 30-60 mins. Slightly open the lid.
procedures.tools: Clean stockpot, filtered water. Use induction or slow cooker if left alone.

notes.title: Shimmering durations
notes.body: Meaty flavor extraction and gelatin extraction has different timetable.

notes.title: Narrow pot
notes.body: Narrow pot helps for small-scale production

notes.title: Reverse Osmosis Water
notes.body: Is the best quality water for this kind of food. Carbon filter is also fine.

notes.title: Oil on roasting
notes.body: Unnecessary, burdening cost and potentially leaving greasy-film on the broth.

notes.title: Roasting liquids
notes.body: Pour on heatproof cup and let it sit for 2-3 mins. Strain golden top layer as a beef tallow. Discard black residue. Add darker juice to the broth. Deglaze brown bits (using the water for broth, do not add more) and add to broth (not when parboiling).

notes.title: Simmer temperature
notes.body: Should not see steam breaking the surface. Tony bubbles. Never rolling boil. Do not add too much water (max 12%).

ingredients.name: Beef Broth Base
ingredients.description: BRIX > 7.0, QC should look like jelly after storing process. For infusion process.

ingredients.name: Optional Beef Broth Base
ingredients.description: Only if need to soften this, produce more volume

ingredients.name: Fish sauce
ingredients.description: Max value, adjust to taste. Add per 5 ml.

ingredients.name: Oxtail concentrate
ingredients.description: An x-factor addition to add unique finish to the broth. Adjusted to taste. Start value.

procedures.title: Remove brisket
procedures.instructions: After 3 hrs, remove brisket and set aside to cool

procedures.title: Strain
procedures.instructions: Strain and discard the aromatics, spices, and mushrooms. Leave a little fat for flavour.

procedures.title: Add beef stock
procedures.instructions: Add broth base until broth reach 2.85L

procedures.title: Add
procedures.instructions: Last, as the final adjustment. Should still be salty.

procedures.title: Add
procedures.instructions: Before fish sauce.
procedures.tools: Slightly sweeter before toned down by fish sauce.

procedures.title: Add X-Factor
procedures.instructions: Adding uniqueness to the broth. If not, reduce the fish sauce. Should still be slightly salty.

ingredients.description: Jamur tiram. Both adjust to taste.

procedures.title: Rinse & Season
procedures.instructions: Salt all sides

procedures.title: Roast & Char
procedures.instructions:
Roast until half-brown, could prepare in advance, up to 2 days. 250°C, 30 mins. 220°C, 45 mins.

Entry time:
• 0 min: Onion
• 5 min: Brisket, Ginger
• 10 min: Garlic
procedures.tools: Store on fridge if in advance. Zip bags to prevent aroma dillutiing others.

procedures.title: Heat
procedures.instructions: Heat over low-medium heat.

procedures.title: Sear
procedures.instructions: Sear brisket on all sides, well-browned. Remove brisket.

procedures.title: Sautee
procedures.instructions:
Shallow fry in beef fat to activate.

Saute shallots and mushroom until golden brown. Add roasted onion, ginger, and garlic for 1 min.

Turn off heat and let them cool down for 1 min.

procedures.title: Sautee
procedures.instructions:
Add cardamom, cinnamon, and star anise. Stir 30 secs until fragrant.

Add coriander seed and cloves last, stir about 20 secs.

procedures.title: Pour and Pre-Season
procedures.instructions: Pur broth. Add salt gradually. Taste, then Totole, yeast extract, and rock sugar. Stir until dissolved.
procedures.tools: Ideal cooking time for brisket and aromatics. More cooking time, aromatics will become bitter.

procedures.title: Return, then Simmer
procedures.instructions:
Return brisket. 

Bring to 90°C. Simmer for 3 hrs. Lid slightly open.

notes.body: Could be added: Lemongrass, Galangal, Candlenut, Nutmeg, Cumin, Daun Salam,
